notes: Roach Modbus Tool v1.3.3 - Updates: the old version no longer crashes as it closes after an update. The cause was found in this version (1.3.1 did not fix it), so the fix takes effect when you update from 1.3.3 to a later version; this update to 1.3.3 may still show the crash once. The update itself was never affected. The update notice is now short: it says a new version is available and offers Update now; what changed is on the release page.
